questions.prompt: Ek motorboat rest se start hoti hai aur 3.0 m/s^2 ke constant acceleration se seedhi line mein chalti hai. 8.0 s ke baad uski velocity kya hogi?
questions.explain: v = u + at. Rest se start matlab u = 0, toh v = 0 + 3.0 * 8.0 = 24 m/s. Jab displacement na diya ho aur na poocha ho, pehli equation of motion sabse seedha rasta hai.

questions.trap_note: Zyada log total path (distance ≈ 2200 m) nikaal dete hain — par poocha DISPLACEMENT hai. 3.5 rounds ke baad athlete diametrically opposite point par hai, toh displacement = diameter.
questions.prompt: Ek athlete 200 m diameter waale circular track ka ek round 40 s mein karta hai. 2 minute 20 second ke baad uska DISPLACEMENT kitna hoga (metres mein)?
questions.explain: 140 s / 40 s = 3.5 rounds. 3 poore rounds ke baad wapas start par (displacement 0), aadha round aur karne par track ke theek saamne waale point par — start se seedhi doori = diameter = 200 m. Distance (path length) hota ~2200 m, par displacement shortest straight line hai.

questions.prompt: Ek car constant speed se circular road par ghoom rahi hai. Uska acceleration zero NAHI hai, kyunki uski ______ lagataar badal rahi hai.
questions.answer: velocity ki direction — speed constant hai, par velocity ek vector hai aur circular path par uski direction har instant badalti hai; velocity badli toh motion accelerated hai.
questions.explain: Acceleration velocity ke CHANGE ki rate hai — aur velocity mein magnitude ke saath direction bhi aata hai. Isliye uniform circular motion hamesha accelerated motion hai, chahe speedometer ek hi number dikhaye.

questions.trap_note: v = 0 dekh kar a = 0 maan lena classic trap hai. Acceleration velocity ki VALUE nahi, uske badalne ki RATE hai — highest point par bhi velocity badal rahi hai (upar se neeche ki taraf palat rahi hai).
questions.prompt: Ek ball ko seedha upar phenka gaya. Apne highest point par uski velocity 0 hai. Us instant par uska acceleration ______ hai.
questions.answer: zero NAHI — acceleration g (approx 9.8 m/s^2, neeche ki taraf) hai. Velocity ek instant ke liye zero hai, par woh continuously badal rahi hai, isliye acceleration wahi ka wahi bana rehta hai.
questions.explain: Agar highest point par a = 0 hota, toh ball wahin latki reh jaati — velocity 0 se kabhi badalti hi nahi. Ball girti hai, matlab velocity badal rahi hai, matlab acceleration hai: g, neeche ki taraf, poore flight ke dauraan.

questions.prompt: Ek train 90 km/h ki speed se chal rahi hai. Brakes lagane par uniform acceleration -0.5 m/s^2 milta hai. Rukne se pehle train kitni doori tay karegi? (Har option kisi na kisi asli galti ka worked-out result hai — trace karke solve karo.)
misconceptions: km/h ko m/s mein convert karna bhool gaye (90^2 / (2*0.5) = 8100)
rukne ka TIME (u/|a| = 50 s) nikaal kar use hi doori maan liya
questions.explain: Pehle conversion: 90 km/h * 5/18 = 25 m/s. Phir teesri equation (time nahi diya): 0 = u^2 + 2as, toh s = u^2 / (2*|a|) = 625 / 1 = 625 m. Galat options exactly wahi numbers hain jo conversion bhoolne, time ko doori samajhne, ya 2 chhodne par aate hain.

questions.prompt: 72 km/h ko m/s mein convert karo.
questions.explain: km/h se m/s ke liye 5/18 se multiply karo: 72 * 5/18 = 20 m/s. Yeh conversion numericals ka gatekeeper hai — Motion ke aadhe sawaal isi par khulte hain.
